message: Fixes the remaining revoke/delete bypass in v10.0.15. The client now binds the installed DPAPI-protected license.dat before the protected game starts, extracts the existing License ID and Hardware ID directly from the stored AITL2 entitlement when available, and performs the remote Supabase access check before launch. The remote authority now accepts either License ID or Hardware ID, so enforcement no longer depends on localhost /api/status discovery. During play, the installed entitlement is re-read and remotely checked every 2 seconds; HTTP 403 immediately terminates the running game and persists the revoke lock. Offline play remains disabled.
